claim.scope: Limitation of historical reconstruction; the assumptions are not enumerated.

provenance.rationale: P027 expressly attributes assumption dependence to historical reconstruction.

signal_basis.value: Historical bookings are reconstructed from separate logs, preserving missing or conflicting entries as unknown. A selected case is replayed, and a smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals do not.
signal_basis.scope: Reconstruction and replay of the selected historical late case.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the reconstruction procedure, selected replay case, observed reduction pattern and failure definition.
No unresolved empirical relation is required for this supported methodological limitation.

rationale: Reconstructing operating conditions from historical records requires assumptions about what those records represent and omit. Successful replay and repeatable reduction do not eliminate that dependence. The claim states only this bounded limitation.
uncertainty: The packet does not enumerate the assumptions or establish whether any particular assumption is false.
